svg.aria-label: The opt-in path, from the G-buffer output with emission in scene RGB and material AO in scene alpha, through preparing depth and the G-buffer once, raw then filtered AO, diffuse ambient with screen AO, emission and direct lights, haze applied once and scene alpha restored to one, to the sky, forward glows and post-processing. The four steps from diffuse ambient to the restore are one lighting dispatch, and material AO stays in scene alpha from the G-buffer output until that restore.
